rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something brings an earlier event or period to mind.

example.english: This song is reminiscent of our school days.
example.traditional: 呢首歌令人諗起我哋以前嘅校園生活。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 ling6 jan4 nam2 hei2 ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 ge3 haau6 jyun4 saang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when the thing evokes the atmosphere or style of an earlier period rather than a particular event.

example.english: The decor of this cha chaan teng is reminiscent of the old days.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳嘅裝修好有懷舊味。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 jau5 waai4 gau6 mei6
